name: leaf107
definition: Only hierarchy leaves; raw edgelist thresholds >=15,000 training and >=35,000 heldout records.

name: distinct heldout branches
definition: Four heldout leaves must occupy four different root branches; all layers in those branches are excluded from training.

name: five node-count strata
definition: Twenty training layers, exactly four from each eligible-node-count quintile.

name: lexicographic minimax
definition: Minimize the largest train-heldout Wu-Palmer similarity; then the total similarity; then maximize total path distance.

name: balanced 2+2 partition
definition: Partition four heldouts into two pairs by minimizing the worse train-to-role mean similarity, then the imbalance; no gene or label data used.

name: heldout-first conditional randomization
definition: Same leaf, threshold, branch-blocking, and size-stratum constraints; random heldout quartet and random training selections within strata.

name: all remaining branches represented
definition: Add at least one training leaf from every non-heldout root branch while retaining four-per-stratum size balance.

name: all144
definition: Allow both hierarchy leaves and internal hierarchy layers, under the same raw thresholds.
